args.text: Popcorn shop. Top: 3 customers wanting popcorn buckets at a counter. Middle: some kitchen/conveyor. Bottom: popcorn machine with a circular gauge (red/yellow/blue) and a dial pointer - looks like a timing/heat meter. Locked slots on right. Bottom card: upgrade for 30 coins, +4 -> +6. 0 coins. I think I press/hold the popcorn machine to cook, maybe release in the yellow zone. Trying a tap on the machine first.

Coins went 0 -> 8 after 3 taps. Popcorn floats up to a machine that fills a bucket, customers buy. Upgrade card bottom has a yellow progress bar filling toward 30. The ring gauge didn't seem to move. Going to tap a bunch more to reach 30.
24 coins. Popcorn piling up in the middle hopper - production faster than serving? The ring around the machine still a mystery; maybe holding heats it toward yellow. Trying a 2 second hold.

Holding moved a needle around the ring clockwise; I let go when it was in the red near 10 o'clock and got +8 (48 coins). One of the dots at the bottom lit up gold. Upgrade card now bright with red arrow - buying it.
Upgrade bought: machine got an awning, coin confetti. Next upgrade 54. Customers gone for now. Now testing the ring: 2s overshot into red, so yellow should be a bit shorter. Trying 1.6s hold.
1.6s landed the needle right in the yellow! 3 gold dots now (was 1) - perfect gives more dots? Customer got popcorn with hearts. 43 coins. Repeating 1.6s to see if I can fill the dot row.

Yellow again, 5 dots. But coins stuck at 43 - no customers at the counter, filled buckets waiting on the belt. So serving depends on customers arriving. Going for a few more perfects to fill the 8 dots.

Filled the 8 dots and got a big popcorn burst - dots reset. That felt good! 53 coins, 1 short of the 54 upgrade. Lots of buckets queued but no customers. The little board top-left now shows several gold dots - maybe it tracks something. One more hold then upgrade.
63 coins - went up 10 even though I saw no customer. Buckets stacking two-high on the belt. Buying the 54 upgrade (cart on wheels).
Cart has wheels now, next upgrade 97. Customer paid +10. The middle panel's bucket icon got a green dot - maybe something to tap there. Curious, tapping it.

Opened a details panel for the packing station: time 4.0 -> 3.0, capacity 15 -> 20, costs 250. The bucket stack has a red 'no' sign - shelf full, 11/8? So the shop counter is my bottleneck, not cooking. Let me check the counter's icon top-left.
Counter panel: 40 coins, customers 4.0 -> 5.5, time 15 -> 11. This is what I need since buckets pile up. 29 coins, waiting a few seconds for sales then buying.
39, one coin short again! Customers are slow. Waiting 4 more seconds then trying to buy the counter upgrade.
